notes.title: 10,000 Wishlists – Thank You!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45256025/207f041792d4ad55bade708a799f5610b085bdc6.gif"][/img][/p][p]We’ve officially hit [b]10,000 wishlists[/b] on Steam!
This is a huge milestone for us, and we want to say [b]thank you[/b] to everyone who has shown support for Lost Host. Knowing that so many people believe in our tiny car’s journey is truly inspiring.[/p][p][b]Development is moving forward![/b]
We’re currently working on a [b]new location – the Village[/b], full of atmosphere and new challenges.
On top of that, [b]racing missions[/b] are coming to the game! While [i]Lost Host[/i] is primarily a story-driven experience, there will be exciting gameplay moments that include racing and time-based challenges.[/p][p]And yes… now the car can [b]jump[/b]!
This new mechanic opens up even more creative and fun ways to explore the world.[/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates – and once again, thank you for being part of this journey.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45256025/d69b1112ead4ec0b860d2cf87078b3899998a6f3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Lost Host completes the Startup Lithuania GameTech accelerator program!
notes.notes: [p]I’ve just completed the [b]Startup Lithuania GameTech accelerator[/b] program with my game [b]Lost Host[/b] 🙂[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45256025/8f20687358e661d19cf06e9273905943d9d33c48.jpg"][/img]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45256025/5b5dd60a0a58883e641bf5c78008c88c2440e002.jpg"][/img]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45256025/ab227ab49f66649eba51783463fe67cee0e177c7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]I'm really happy that so many people like the game :>[/p][p]Along the way, I met a lot of amazing people who helped with the project’s development.[/p][p][b]Big thanks to everyone who supported and stood by me![/b][/p][p]We also received funding for the game, which is super exciting and important for the continued development of the project.[/p][p]There’s still lots of work and exciting events ahead, hehe :>[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45256025/7b2f2ad7614273392e98e54ee89196d062a4efe0.jpg"][/img]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45256025/d002601de136b0d07004f7e6142351e27f1f6905.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Big thanks to [url="https://www.linkedin.com/company/startup-lithuania/"][b]Startup Lithuania[/b][/url] [url="https://www.linkedin.com/company/innovation-agency-lithuania/"][b]Inovacijų agentūra[/b][/url] [url="https://www.linkedin.com/company/gamebcn/"][b]GameBCN[/b][/url][/p]

notes.title: It’s been an amazing weekend at Comic Con Baltics!
notes.notes:
So many people of all ages played the demo, gave us feedback, and shared laughs and challenges together. Some kids were better drivers than their parents 👀🚗

We thought we had squashed all the bugs... but of course, Comic Con helped us find a few more 🐞😅
Big thanks to everyone who tested, asked questions, and just vibed with the little car’s journey. It’s such a joy to watch people play the thing you’ve been working on for months.
[b]

notes.title: Lost Host @ Comic Con Baltics 2025
notes.notes:
[b]Lost Host[/b] will be at [b]Comic Con Baltics 2025[/b]!

We’re excited to announce that Lost Host will be playable at Comic Con Baltics 2025, on May 23, at the Developers’ Terrace in [b]Vilnius[/b]!

Visitors will get a chance to try out our early demo and experience the game first-hand.
We’re currently working hard to polish everything in time, and we can’t wait to share it with you in person.

We’re also bringing some Lost Host stickers. 🙂
If you're attending Comic Con - come say hi! We’d love to hear what you think.
[i][b]See you in Vilnius![/b][/i]

notes.title: Lost Host Joins Startup Lithuania GameTech!
notes.notes:
Lost Host Joins Startup Lithuania GameTech!
We’re excited to share that Lost Host has been selected to join the Startup Lithuania GameTech program - powered by GameBCN!

[img]https://cdna.artstation.com/p/assets/images/images/086/713/794/4k/pasha-gesta-mainlosthost.jpg?1743878144[/img]

This is a huge milestone for our team. Being part of this program will help us grow and continue developing the game with more confidence and support.

We're incredibly grateful for this opportunity - and for your support. Every Steam Wishlist helps and motivates us to keep going. :)

Check out the project: [url=https://gest.lt/projects/JvElVz]https://gest.lt/projects/JvElVz[/url]
Learn more about the program: [url=https://gametech.gamebcn.co]https://gametech.gamebcn.co[/url]

More news soon - stay tuned!
